name: 3M Aura 9205+ N95 particulate respirator
summary: A disposable particulate respirator documented by 3M as N95. Correct selection, fit and genuine supply matter; this is not protection against gases, vapours or oxygen deficiency.
description: Respiratory protection starts with identifying the hazard and selecting a suitable respirator. The Aura 9205+ is a three-panel filtering facepiece for specified non-oil particulates, rather than a general-purpose escape mask. A catalogue page cannot establish fit or authenticity. Read the supplied instructions, obtain the required fit testing and training for occupational use, and choose a genuine supply channel.

specs.label: Documented class
specs.value: NIOSH N95 for certain non-oil particles; not a delivered-unit authenticity claim

specs.label: Fit features
specs.value: Adjustable nose clip and nose foam

specs.label: Headbands
specs.value: Two stapled headbands; not ear loops

specs.label: Approval reference
specs.value: 3M Canadian technical sheet identifies TC-84A-8590 for the documented model

pros: Flat-fold form is convenient to store in its original packaging.
The manufacturer provides model-specific instructions and Canadian technical documentation.
cons: No gas, vapour or oxygen-supply capability.
A poor face seal can defeat the intended protection.
Seller, lot, expiry date, package quantity and authenticity are not independently verified.
useCases: Include appropriate particulate protection in a workplace plan selected through a hazard assessment.
Keep genuine, undamaged packaged respirators for tasks within the manufacturer limits.

safetyNotes: Do not use for gases, vapours, oxygen deficiency, unknown concentrations or immediately dangerous atmospheres.
Facial hair or other interference at the seal can prevent a proper fit; follow the manufacturer instructions and required fit testing.
This model is for appropriately trained adults within its instructions; it is not a surgical fluid-resistance or universal infection-prevention guarantee.
Replace a dirty, damaged or difficult-to-breathe-through respirator. Suspected counterfeit units should not be used.
